area: Multiple Dubai branches (about 8 in 2025), including Burj Vista Downtown, Nakheel Mall Palm Jumeirah, Dubai Hills Mall and Creek Harbour

avoid_dishes.dish: Anything with hoisin, regular soy sauce or oyster sauce

avoid_dishes.reason: Ask about batter and shared fryers

name: Vietnamese Foodies
questions: Is the pho broth seasoned with soy, hoisin or fish sauce containing wheat?
Do you have tamari or GF soy sauce?
Do you have a GF dipping sauce for the rolls?
quinoa_oat_flags: Unknown. Ask whether any 'healthy' bowls or salads use quinoa.

safe_dishes.dish: Pho (beef brisket with 14-hour bone broth, or vegan pho)
safe_dishes.note: Rice noodles. Confirm the broth and any sauces added.
Confirm the dipping sauce. Hoisin and soy-based sauces usually contain wheat.

summary: A popular Vietnamese chain that advertises gluten-free dishes. No dish-level GF list was found, so ask at ordering. Pho and rolls are the likely safe picks.
